question: The greatest common factor (HCF) of two numbers is 16 and their least common multiple (LCM) is 240. If one number is 48, find the other number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

We know that: First Number × Second Number = HCF × LCM

Second Number = (HCF × LCM) ÷ First Number

Second Number = (16 × 240) ÷ 48

Second Number = 240 ÷ 3 = 80

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF = 16

LCM = 240

One number = 48

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

**Calculations:**

⇒ 48 × Other Number = 16 × 240

⇒ Other Number = (16 × 240) ÷ 48

⇒ Other Number = 240 ÷ 3

⇒ Other Number = 80

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation between HCF and LCM

The product of any two given numbers is always equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. (A × B = HCF × LCM)

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are considered co-prime if their highest common factor (HCF) is 1. The LCM of two co-prime numbers is exactly equal to their product.

Fractions Rule

LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators)
HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators)
